explication: MudBlazor is a Material Design component framework for Blazor. The principal workflow is: a .NET developer configures MudBlazor components, the Blazor runtime renders them in the browser, and component interactions use internal services such as scrolling and JavaScript interop. The repository also contains a documentation application with API/example endpoints and Roslyn analyzers with code fixes. Several component and documentation relationships are inferred only from the tree; sampled source directly confirms the scroll and host/controller wiring.
